title: Spoken Finnish (puhekieli)
body: Everyday spoken Finnish. It can mean spoken forms like mä oon instead of minä olen, and also casual everyday words like telkkari instead of televisio.
example: minä olen -> mä oon; televisio -> telkkari

title: Standard Finnish (kirjakieli / yleiskieli)
body: The shared standard form used in news, textbooks, instructions, official writing, and careful or formal speech.

title: Slang
body: A more specific informal language used by a group, age group, profession, hobby, or place.
